Agent Name: Geography_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Geography_Expert failed to correctly identify supermarkets within 2 blocks of Lincoln Park in Chicago during their first step of verification. Instead, they relied on inaccurate data about the proximity of Whole Foods Market, Costco, and Menards, which were all significantly farther than 2 blocks from Lincoln Park. This incorrect initial assumption led to the propagation of errors throughout the conversation, including the misclassification of qualifying stores and failure to address the real-world problem effectively.
